$comment: The Piggles billing plan — Piggles' policy, owned by Piggles.
One flat plan, every app included, capacity as the only variable axis
(docs/initial/docs/commercial/BILLING_RULES.md). It must never grow tiers, and
nothing in this file can be arranged into a Basic/Pro/Enterprise grid because
there is only one plan in it. There is deliberately no annual price either —
'Piggles is $49/month' is the whole sentence the marketing site says.
It lives here and not in @wizeworks/billing because a plan's shape and prices are
brand policy: the platform owns the engine, the brand owns what it charges
(wizeworks/CLAUDE.md, 'Entitlements are a mechanism here and a policy there').
TWO CONSUMERS, ONE FILE, so the prices cannot drift:
1. scripts/provision-stripe.mjs reads it to create the Stripe catalog.
2. api-rest reads it as the BILLING_PLANS env value, shipped by ops.
Change a price here, re-run the provisioner, re-ship the env — in that order.
'secretEnv' is the load-bearing field: it names the env var holding the Stripe
key, and therefore WHICH ACCOUNT a Piggles business is charged in. Piggles has
its own Stripe account because the two products bill on incompatible models.
label: Flat monthly
